title: Ewen Cameron examines Rudolf Hess to see whether he was a double

tellings.quote: figure out is this really Herman Hess or is it a double? Right.

plain: In England in the 1940s, the psychiatrist Ewen Cameron is said to have examined Rudolf Hess, Hitler's deputy, who was then held by the British, to work out whether the prisoner was really Hess or a double. Peter Levenda, a writer on the history of intelligence and the occult, tells Michels this without naming a source. If true, it would mean the Allies themselves doubted who they were holding.
